reels.caption:
First FULL house tour! 🤍

For the last two years, I've poured so much time, energy and love into turning this house into our home, and we're finally getting close to the finish line.

There's still a few things to finish upstairs, and yes… the green carpet in our bedroom definitely has to go (we all make questionable design choices at some point 😂), but overall I'm so happy with how everything is coming together.

There's still lots of styling to do, artwork to hang and pops of colour to add, but I wanted to get the foundations right first.

I hope you enjoy having a little look around our home ✨ xx

Walk through it, however, and the entire house opens toward a private desert oasis.
